keyId.description: Identifier of the key to sign with. The key MUST be `active`. Which keys a producer may name is the whole of this task's authorization story — the maintainer signs the bytes it is given without inspecting them.

payload.description: The exact bytes to sign, base64url-encoded without padding. The maintainer signs these bytes verbatim: it does not parse, canonicalize, or wrap them.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm to use. MUST be compatible with the named key's `keyType`.

Response.title: Keys Sign — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a keys/sign request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/keys/sign/0.1#response.

keyId.description: The key that produced the signature. Echoed so a response separated from its request is still attributable.
